headline: Rain is affecting Houston; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Rain at Houston Intercontinental (IAH) is affecting operations there and can cause minor delays.
The other hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far today are at 85% on time or better.
The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) until 9:00 PM ET. It is not in effect.

A ground stop is holding flights into Boston (BOS) until 6:45 PM ET because of runway construction, and the FAA rates the chance of an extension as medium. A possible program for flights into Seattle (SEA) after 6:00 PM PT is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Boston, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
